Emma — thanks for the note and for attaching the W-9. We try to be pragmatic for pilots and small customers, so a temporary invoice-only path is possible, but it requires approval from Finance and a short evidence checklist first.

I copied Markus (Finance lead) to scope the criteria. Can you confirm the following items so we can speed review:
- Billing legal entity and VAT/EIN (if different from W-9)
- Expected monthly spend during pilot (estimate)
- PO timeline (when you expect to be in your AP system)
- Any additional contract/legal needs (NDA/SOW)

If you can also sign the attached exceptions form, it short-circuits the process. Proposed constraint from our side: 90-day temporary exception, capped at $12k total, with invoices due Net30 and acceptance of Redwood's pilot SOW.

If that looks ok I’ll get Finance to triage and, if approved, route the signed exception to Legal for countersignature.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Lauren / Emma — appreciate you flagging this. A few notes from Finance:

1) Policy baseline: Redwood requires a PO for all recurring or contractually bound spend > $5k/month. For one-off/trial engagements we allow an invoice-only onboarding pathway if the vendor provides standard evidence and we issue an internal exception.

2) Evidence we need (please refer to checklist Lauren attached): W-9, billing contact, bank remit details, pilot scope (SOW), estimated spend, and a primary business contact. For first-time vendors we also request SOC2 type II or equivalent security attestation when the integration will access customer data; otherwise an outline of security controls and data handling is sufficient.

3) Proposed guardrails for this exception:
- 90-day exception window
- $12k hard cap on invoices during the pilot
- Signed exception authorization (attached) by the customer's CFO or Ops lead
- Redwood reserves right to pause service if invoices exceed cap or obligations (SOW/acceptance) not met

If you can get the W-9 and SOW over plus a short confirmation of estimated spend, we can triage for approval today and aim to have the signed exception issued by tomorrow.

I’m attaching the formal exception authorization template — sign/scan back to me. Priyom will be the approver for this pilot exception.

— Markus
Markus Klein
